detector: frozen event_duration_weather@0.25; assert every14-hour mask and timing against previous snapshots; no retraining
guards: site34929, original06UTC lead10–23, March–May; missing fields/unknown registry date/extrapolation/unseen fitted regime => no guarded corrected prediction
deployment: station research only; field GFS and original models unchanged; no chosen orchard, no crop-damage probability
